notes: LEGAL FORM: self-describes as a non-profit homeowner's association, not a municipal fire district -- the second such case found, after Westford FD 1. Created 1987 to acquire, upgrade, operate and maintain the water system for the Goldbrook/Dewey Hill area; states it serves 42 residents/property owners (our roster records population 86, which is consistent if 42 counts properties). Two wells, at 274 Goldbrook Circle and 251 Dewey Hill Road, with a pump station at the former. OPERATIONS FULLY CONTRACTED: Simon Operation Service is the utility operator and regulatory consultant, Endyne Labs does monthly sampling, Mossey Bookkeeping does the books, T.S. Peck carries insurance -- no district staff. Contact stowefiredistrict2@gmail.com. Publishes no documents: the site is Wix with no PDFs, correcting an earlier automated guess that documents sat behind an embedded viewer. Read by the project lead, 2026-09-08.
